vaultBoundaries.identity: Caller-pinned complete local PS manifest and 16-byte vault ID; inner content rechecks both.
vaultBoundaries.freshness: No version counter, anti-rollback, expiry or revocation. Older valid vault exports still decrypt. Re-sealing under another password does not revoke older files.

limitations: Original same-author local research; public PS issuer fixture keys and demo password; unsuitable for real assets. Independent reviewer remains unassigned and result pending.
Encrypted export files do not encrypt the working client/issuer/observer SQLite stores. Explicit reads and restore return/store plaintext; no browser/v1 vault integration.

Fixed synchronous scrypt settings are bounded lab policy, not reviewed production password/device/admission parameters. Weak passwords permit offline guessing; rate-limited hosted password unlock and aggregate resource qualification are absent.
Owned key/intermediate buffers are zero-filled best effort. JS strings, caller copies, crypto backend allocations, GC, swap/crash dumps and secure memory are not qualified. Lock is an API boundary.
Outer issuer manifest, stable vault ID and ciphertext length are visible. The file is not a wallet endorsement, status receipt or proof of unspent ownership.
Old exports remain decryptable and can omit later operations. Password changes do not revoke old copies; no revision rollback defense, automatic client synchronization or retention/deletion policy.

Exclusive file creation and fsync are not atomic publication, parent-directory durability, power-loss or real-device qualification. A failed export can leave a partial file; prior backups are preserved and retry uses a new path.
Filesystem helpers assume trusted private parent directories and local process; Windows, malicious hard links/parent replacement, concurrent editing and hardware/IOERR are not qualified.
Typed malformed cases are selected same-author coverage, not exhaustive fuzzing or independent cryptographic vectors. No new process-kill or filesystem fault controls were added.
Wallet bytes remain context only and walletAuthenticated false; public showing linkage, issuer honesty/equivocation, fresh-observer rollback and manipulated clocks/trust remain outside guarantees.
C2 local harness complete; C1/C3 partial; independent C4 pending; C5 local file/export-vault preparation only; custody approval, production trust/key lifecycle and C6 hosting remain open.
No live interoperability, audit, production privacy or ordinary MetaMask NFT custody claim. Derived issuer equations and extra cross-group checks remain lab choices.
